Our goal is to make sure your service experience is the most awesome it can be! | Who We Are at East Bay Automotive Sales & Service | David del Regato | Owner & Man Wearing Many Hats | David fell in love with the automotive industry at 16 as a detail specialist reconditioning vehicles. He spent the majority of his adult years learning the business from the inside out, working in sales, service, finance, and various management positions. He always envisioned a process to provide a better experience to customers. Whether it be sales or service, David prides himself on upfront communication, best-in-industry pricing, and streamlined processes. When he's not at the shop (which is seldom), he spends his time tinkering with his cars or enjoying life with his wife, Melissa, and 3 daughters. | Drew Serrano | Service & Shop Manager Extraordinaire | Drew has excelled in the automotive industry for 18+ years, working for several automotive brands, including Ford, Chrysler, Dodge, Ram, Jeep, Chevrolet, Porsche, and Audi. Drew’s experience started in the parts department, then expanded into sales, service, and shop management, as well as management of a full detail department spanning 8 dealership locations. He specializes in customer service and problem solving. When not busy at work, he is usually running around with his wife and 4 children, as well as (almost always) dabbling in woodwork. | Melissa Allen | Behind the Scenes Wizard | Melissa started in the automotive industry in 2012, learning the administrative side of a dealership at one of Pensacola's largest dealers. After a few years, she moved industries and focused on HR and IT management services, obtaining her HR and ITIL certificates. Fast forward a few years - she now splits her time between East Bay Automotive Sales & Service, managing HR, accounting, and most things behind the scenes, volunteering at her 3 daughters schools, as well as chauffeuring them to and from activities. In her sporadic spare time, she enjoys traveling and spending quality time with her husband David, daughters, and dogs. | Shannon Gibson | Sr. Technician | Shannon has worked in the automotive industry for 40 years, focusing on performance and electrical. He possesses extensive automotive knowledge and a witty personality. Prior to working at East Bay Automotive Sales & Service, he owned his own shop in Pensacola. Due to his experience and excellence, he has earned the titles of “Shop Foreman” and “Master Technician.” If he is not working on cars, he’s out on the river hunting and fishing with his 2 sons. | Bob Goebel | Sr. Technician | Bob has worked in the industry for almost 50 years and possesses more than just a 'well-rounded' knowledge of cars- he's 'The Professor'! Though Bob started in the industry as a Rolls-Royce and Toyota technician, he spent most of his career working for Chrysler wherever he was needed. Due to his numerous years of dedication and wisdom, he has earned the title of “Master Humble Technician.” We have not tested our theory; however, we believe he has the record for fastest engine removal, overhaul, and reinstall. On a serious note, when he isn't tinkering here at East Bay Automotive Sales & Service, he is with his Family- his wife, children, and grandkids are very important to him- and he loves spending any chance he gets with them. | Rusty Stringfellow | Technician | Rusty, originally from Perry, Fl. started in the automotive business over 7 years ago doing tires. Before joining the East Bay team in 2026, he was restoring and rebuilding classic vehicles. When it comes to the industry, Rusty loves that it is ever changing and there's always more to learn; hence motivating him to stay in the industry until he retires! Rusty has a calm, thorough and steadfast approach to his work. In his spare time, he loves being outdoors fishing and hunting and loves survival shows- maybe one day he will be on Naked and Afraid! | Reagan Kennington | Jr. Technician | Reagan is new to the automotive industry but not at all unfamiliar with cars. He has worked on cars with his dad since he was 10 years old, which led him to fall in love with the industry. Before graduating high school, he routinely stopped in at East Bay Automotive Sales & Service Automotive to ask if we were hiring. After graduating, he started to pursue a career in the medical field but decided to switch gears and dive into the automotive industry, where he felt more at home. Reagan is very thorough in his approach and eager to gain experience in the industry, always quick to lend a helping hand. In his free time, he likes to go fishing with friends and spend time with family. | Bruce Turley | Jr. Technician | Bruce has been in the industry since beginning his automotive studies at Locklin Tech in 2018. Bruce has had a few years experience at larger dealerships, but the smaller shops are where he prefers to shine. His favorite thing about the industry is being able to see a 20+ year old vehicle be resorted and back to life after being neglected. If Bruce could have any superpower it would be invisibility- but don't let that confuse you- he's a super friendly and social guy. subpages.text_content: Auto Services and Repair | Service Detail | Home | Services | Inventory | Direct2You Sales | Who We Are | Contact Us | More | Home | Services | Inventory | Direct2You Sales | Who We Are | Contact Us | Home | Services | Inventory | Direct2You Sales | Who We Are | Contact Us | More About | Oils Well That Ends Well | Oil Changes: | Draining and replacing your engine oil with vehicle-required and customer-preferred oil. Replace the engine oil filter and do a 32-point safety inspection. Keeping your vehicle properly serviced with regular oil changes is the best preventative maintenance. | Big Wheels Keep on Turnin' | Tires & More: | Inspection of tires, patch repair of minor punctures, determining wear and lifespan, and replacing your old tires with a new set. | Tire rotation and balancing of all 4 tires (or 5 to include the spare). 2- and 4-wheel alignments. | Everything's Fluid- Ever Changing | Fluids & Flushes: | Often forgotten, the vehicle fluids that protect parts from wear and tear eventually break down and decompose and need regular flushing at certain service intervals or as they age and become dirty. We'll check your fluids to keep your vehicle running safely and smoothly. | Can't Slow Down | Brake Service & Replacements: | Brake inspections, machining or replacement of rotors, pads, calipers, check and replace brake fluid, etc. Our technicians can check for uneven wear and reassure your brakes remain in the best possible condition. | Tune Me Up, Scotty | Tune-Ups & Maintenance: | Tuning up and completing the necessary maintenance is vital for your vehicle’s overall longevity. Most of us do not perform the same way we did 5-10 years ago; the same goes with your ride! It’s not only a great idea to keep your service up to date; more importantly, it saves you money and frustration in the long run. We complete full factory OEM tune-ups as well as inspect wires/coil boots. We will check all the components to keep you running smoothly. | It's Getting Hot in Here | A/C System Check: | Inspection of coolant, compressor/condenser, and cooling fans. Check the system for proper cooling temps and any loose hoses and wiring to keep you comfortable no matter what the temperature is. | Help! I Need Somebody | Diagnostics & Repairs: | Just as your vehicle’s fluids can get old, dirty, and filled with contaminants, so can your filters. Replacing your filters helps you and your vehicle ‘breathe’ better, prolong engine life as well as increase MPG. As part of our 32-point inspection, we look at the condition of your cabin air filter, engine air filter, and fuel filters and will recommend replacement if needed. | Be a Filter, Not a Sponge | Filters: | Just as your vehicle’s fluids can get old, dirty, and filled with contaminants, so can your filters. Replacing your filters helps you and your vehicle ‘breathe’ better and prolongs engine life as well as increases MPG. As part of our 32-point inspection, we look at the condition of your cabin air filter, engine air filter, and fuel filters and will recommend replacement if needed. | You Charge Me Up | Batteries: | No one wants to be stranded due to a dead car battery. We can inspect and clean your battery terminals, determine if your battery is providing ample voltage to power your starter motor and replace older drained batteries in order to keep you running. | I Can See Clearly Now | Bulbs and Wipers: | Be sure your visibility is 100%. We check and replace all bulbs (headlamps, brake lights, signal, tag lights and interior lights).
